name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lower the bar to mid-chest with elbows about 45 degrees from your body, then press back to lockout.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Set the bench to 30 degrees and press from the upper chest.

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: On a declined bench, lower to the lower chest and press up.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Press two dumbbells from chest level, letting them travel slightly inward at the top.

name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Press from the upper chest on a 30 degree incline.

name: Dumbbell Fly
instructions: With a soft elbow bend, open your arms wide and bring them together above the chest.

name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Same arc as a flat fly, performed on an incline.

name: Cable Crossover
instructions: Step forward between two high pulleys and bring the handles together in front of you.

name: Cable Fly (Low to High)
instructions: Sweep the handles upward and inward from hip height to chest height.

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Press the handles forward with the seat set so the handles sit at chest height.

name: Pec Deck
instructions: Bring the pads together in front of your chest with a fixed elbow angle.

name: Push-Up
instructions: Keep a straight line from head to heels and lower until your chest is just off the floor.

name: Incline Push-Up
instructions: Hands elevated on a bench or bar; easier than a floor push-up.

name: Decline Push-Up
instructions: Feet elevated, which shifts the load toward the upper chest and shoulders.

name: Diamond Push-Up
instructions: Hands close together under the chest, elbows tracking back.

name: Chest Dip
instructions: Lean the torso forward and let the elbows flare slightly to bias the chest.

name: Smith Machine Bench Press
instructions: A fixed bar path; useful when pressing heavy without a spotter.

name: Svend Press
instructions: Squeeze a ball between your palms and press it straight out from the chest.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang with an overhand grip and pull until your chin clears the bar.

name: Chin-Up
instructions: Underhand grip, which lets the biceps contribute more than a pull-up.

name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
instructions: Palms facing each other - usually the most shoulder-friendly variation.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Pull the bar to your upper chest, leading with the elbows rather than the hands.

name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: A narrow or neutral grip that increases the range at the bottom.

name: Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge to about 45 degrees and row the bar to your lower ribs.

name: Pendlay Row
instructions: Row explosively from a dead stop on the floor with a flat back.

name: One Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Brace a hand and knee on the bench and row the dumbbell to your hip.

name: Chest-Supported Row
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench so the lower back does no work.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Pull the handle to your navel and keep the torso still.

name: T-Bar Row
instructions: Straddle a landmine bar and row it to your chest.

name: Inverted Row
instructions: Hang under a fixed bar with straight legs and pull your chest to the bar.

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
instructions: With locked elbows, sweep the bar from overhead down to your thighs.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
instructions: Lower one dumbbell behind your head in an arc and pull it back over your chest.

name: Machine Row
instructions: A supported row with a fixed path.

name: Deadlift
instructions: Drive the floor away with a neutral spine and lock out at the hips.

name: Rack Pull
instructions: A partial deadlift from pins at or just below the knee.

name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Lift the shoulders straight up; no rolling.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: Same movement with dumbbells at your sides.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Pull a rope to your forehead with the elbows high and rotate outward.

name: Back Extension
instructions: Hinge at the hips over a pad and extend to a straight line, not beyond.

name: Good Morning
instructions: With the bar on your back, hinge forward with soft knees and a flat spine.

name: Overhead Press
instructions: Press from the front rack to lockout with the ribs down and glutes tight.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Press two dumbbells overhead from ear height.

name: Arnold Press
instructions: Start palms-in and rotate outward as you press.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: A supported overhead press with a fixed path.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Raise the dumbbells out to shoulder height leading with the elbows.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: A lateral raise with constant tension through the whole range.

name: Machine Lateral Raise
instructions: Supported lateral raise against pads.

name: Front Raise
instructions: Raise the weight straight in front of you to shoulder height.

name: Reverse Fly
instructions: Hinge forward and open the arms wide with soft elbows.

name: Reverse Pec Deck
instructions: Face the pad and sweep the handles backward.

name: Upright Row
instructions: Pull the bar to chest height with the elbows leading, keeping the grip wide.

name: Band Pull-Apart
instructions: Hold a band at shoulder height and pull it apart until your arms are wide.

name: Cuban Rotation
instructions: Row to a high-elbow position, rotate up, then press. Light weight only.

name: Pike Push-Up
instructions: Hips high, lower the crown of your head toward the floor between your hands.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Curl the bar with the elbows pinned to your sides.

name: EZ-Bar Curl
instructions: The angled grip is easier on the wrists than a straight bar.

name: Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Curl one or both dumbbells, supinating as you rise.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Neutral grip throughout, which loads the brachialis and forearm.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Curl with the arms hanging behind you on an incline bench for a longer stretch.

name: Preacher Curl
instructions: Curl over a preacher pad so the upper arms cannot swing.

name: Cable Curl
instructions: Constant tension from a low pulley.

name: Concentration Curl
instructions: Seated, elbow braced against the inner thigh.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Shoulder-width grip, elbows tucked, press from the lower chest.

name: Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Push the bar or rope down to lockout with the elbows fixed at your sides.

name: Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Lower the weight behind your head and extend, keeping the elbows narrow.

name: Skull Crusher
instructions: Lower the bar toward your forehead with the upper arms vertical.

name: Triceps Dip
instructions: Stay upright and lower until the elbows reach about 90 degrees.

name: Bench Dip
instructions: Hands on a bench behind you, lower the hips toward the floor.

name: Kickback
instructions: Hinge forward and extend the elbow straight back.

name: Wrist Curl
instructions: Forearms on your thighs, curl the weight up with the wrists only.

name: Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Palms down; extend the wrists against the load.

name: Farmer's Carry
instructions: Carry a heavy weight in each hand and walk with tall posture.

name: Back Squat
instructions: Bar on the upper back; sit down and back to at least parallel, then drive up.

name: Front Squat
instructions: Bar in the front rack with the elbows high, which keeps the torso upright.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold one dumbbell at your chest and squat between your knees.

name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Squat to depth with your heels down and chest up.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Rear foot elevated; lower straight down over the front leg.

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Step forward and lower the back knee toward the floor, then step through.

name: Reverse Lunge
instructions: Step backward instead of forward - usually easier on the knees.

name: Step-Up
instructions: Drive through the top foot without pushing off the trailing leg.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Press the platform away without letting the lower back round at the bottom.

name: Hack Squat
instructions: A machine squat with the back supported.

name: Smith Machine Squat
instructions: A fixed-path squat, useful for training close to failure alone.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Extend the knees against the pad and control the way down.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Push the hips back with soft knees until you feel the hamstrings, then stand.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: The same hip hinge with dumbbells.

name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
instructions: A hinge with near-straight legs and a long hamstring stretch.

name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Curl the pad toward your glutes without lifting the hips.

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Seated version, which trains the hamstrings in a lengthened position.

name: Nordic Curl
instructions: Anchor the ankles and lower your torso forward as slowly as you can.

name: Hip Thrust
instructions: Shoulders on a bench, drive the hips to full extension and squeeze.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: From the floor, lift the hips until the body forms a straight line.

name: Cable Kickback
instructions: Drive one leg backward against the cable with a still torso.

name: Hip Abduction Machine
instructions: Press the knees outward against the pads.

name: Hip Adduction Machine
instructions: Squeeze the knees together against the pads.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Rise onto the toes through a full range and pause at the top.

name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Bent knees bias the soleus rather than the gastrocnemius.

name: Dumbbell Calf Raise
instructions: Hold dumbbells and rise onto the toes, ideally off a step.

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Hinge and snap the hips to float the bell to chest height. It is not a squat.

name: Box Jump
instructions: Jump onto a box and land softly with bent knees. Step down, do not jump down.

name: Plank
instructions: Hold a straight line from head to heels with the glutes and abs braced.

name: Side Plank
instructions: Stack the hips and hold, keeping the bottom shoulder packed.

name: Hollow Body Hold
instructions: Press the lower back into the floor and hold arms and legs off it.

name: Dead Bug
instructions: Extend the opposite arm and leg without letting the lower back arch.

name: Crunch
instructions: Curl the ribs toward the hips; this is a short range, not a sit-up.

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneel under a high pulley and crunch the ribs down toward the knees.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang and raise straight legs to hip height without swinging.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: The bent-knee version of the leg raise.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Roll out only as far as you can go without the lower back arching.

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Seated and leaning back, rotate the ball from hip to hip.

name: Pallof Press
instructions: Press a cable straight out while resisting the pull to rotate.

name: Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Alternate elbow to opposite knee with the legs cycling.

name: Mountain Climber
instructions: From a push-up position, drive the knees to the chest alternately.

name: Stability Ball Rollout
instructions: Forearms on the ball, roll it away and pull it back with the abs.

name: Burpee
instructions: Drop to a push-up, jump the feet in, and stand or jump.

name: Thruster
instructions: A front squat straight into an overhead press.

name: Clean and Press
instructions: Pull the bar to the front rack, then press it overhead.

name: Turkish Get-Up
instructions: Stand up and lie back down with a weight locked overhead. Go slowly.

name: Bear Crawl
instructions: Crawl with the knees an inch off the floor and the hips low.

name: Battle Rope Waves
instructions: Alternate arms to send waves down the rope without losing your brace.

name: Treadmill Run
instructions: Run at a steady pace or in intervals.

name: Outdoor Run
instructions: Road or trail running.

name: Stationary Bike
instructions: Steady-state or interval cycling.

name: Rowing Machine
instructions: Drive with the legs, then the back, then the arms.

name: Elliptical
instructions: Low-impact steady-state work.

name: Stair Climber
instructions: Climb without leaning on the handles.

name: Jump Rope
instructions: Small hops off the balls of the feet.

name: Sled Push
instructions: Push a loaded sled with a low body angle and short steps.

name: Cat-Cow
instructions: Alternate arching and rounding the spine on all fours.

name: Hip Flexor Stretch
instructions: Half-kneeling, tuck the pelvis and press the hips forward.

name: Thoracic Rotation
instructions: On all fours, hand behind the head, rotate the ribs open.

name: Shoulder Dislocate
instructions: Pass a band overhead and behind you with straight arms.

name: Couch Stretch
instructions: Rear foot up a wall in a half-kneel; tuck the pelvis.

name: Deep Squat Hold
instructions: Sit in the bottom of a squat and breathe.
